purpose: This table provides cleaned 2013 NYC flight departure and arrival records at the granularity of one scheduled flight (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin), feeding downstream analytics on on-time performance, delays, and route volume.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time as nullable fields reflecting cancelled or unrecorded flights and must filter or account for these nulls explicitly rather than assuming every scheduled flight has a recorded outcome; time_hour is a TIMESTAMP suitable for time-based joins and bucketing.
limitations: Roughly 2.9-3.3% of rows lack dep_time, arr_time, arr_delay, or air_time data (null_counts 4883-5480), and 0.9% of rows lack a tailnum (null_count 1521); the proposed grain of year, month, day, carrier, flight, and origin has not been measured against the warehouse for true uniqueness and should be validated before approval, and no exact duplicate rows were detected at a 0.0 duplicate_row_rate so no dedupe logic was applied.
